## Maintenance rules (v1 legacy, still binding))

- This network is a living document: couplings discovered during BUILD/VERIFY land via `gos map edge add` (audit receipt).
- New sections / commands: tag the section header with `# gos-map:cmd <cmd>` (scan picks it up for testof).
- Line-number anchors are obsolete (v2 anchor kinds: cmd:/fn:/sec:/h:/contract key); the v1 line table moved into the extractor.
- v1 originals are archived in git history (Phase C era network.md).
